Existing cubic B-spline casing outline remains an approximation. This increment does not establish its historical contour or resolve drawing scale discrepancies.

Four MX5 case mounting studs, shifter controls, lubrication and standard-tank integration remain pending.

Gasket geometry is extruded from the rear casting mating land; mirrored reuse and support against the front cover must pass independent checks. This is fitted reconstruction geometry, not a printed gasket drawing.
